Comments: Located in granule cell layer of cerebellar cortex; most numerous neurons in brain (~50 billion in humans). Receives mossy fiber (MF) input from MVN via dendritic claws (4-5 MFs per cell); outputs high-dimensional sparse representation to Purkinje cells via parallel fibers (PF). Performs expansion coding that transforms convergent MF inputs into high-dimensional sparse PF representation essential for VOR learning context coding. ROI-internal.

Sole output neuron of cerebellar cortex located in Purkinje cell layer. Integrates ~100,000 parallel fiber synapses (from GC) and one climbing fiber (from IO-DC) on its extensive dendritic arbor. Primary site of LTD (long-term depression) and LTP (long-term potentiation) plasticity for VOR learning. Sends GABAergic inhibitory output to floccular target neurons (FTN) in MVN. ROI-internal.

Located in granule cell layer; largest and most abundant inhibitory interneuron in cerebellum. Provides feedback inhibition (via parallel fibers from GC) and feedforward inhibition (via mossy fibers from MVN) to granule cell dendrites at cerebellar glomeruli (GABA/glycinergic). Maintains sparse coding of granule cell activity by limiting simultaneous GC firing. ROI-internal.

Located in inner molecular layer; inhibitory interneuron. Receives excitatory parallel fiber input from GC; provides powerful lateral inhibition to PC soma and axon initial segment via characteristic pinceau (basket) structure of GABAergic axon terminals. Controls PC output timing and magnitude; sharpens temporal precision of VOR-related Purkinje cell signals. ROI-internal.

Located in outer molecular layer; inhibitory interneuron. Receives excitatory parallel fiber input from GC; provides inhibitory output to outer dendritic shafts of Purkinje cells. Located near climbing fiber synaptic sites on PC dendrites; modulates CF-PF coincidence detection and LTD induction threshold. ROI-internal.

Names: Medial Vestibular Nucleus / Floccular Target Neuron (FTN)
Comments: Located at ponto-medullary junction. Dual role: (1) Receives vestibular afferent input from CN VIII and provides mossy fiber input to cerebellar granule cells (GC) encoding head velocity and efference copy signals (noROI input); (2) Serves as floccular target neuron (FTN) receiving GABAergic inhibition from Purkinje cells (PC) and projecting to oculomotor nuclei (OMN) (noROI output). Site of late-phase synaptic plasticity during learning consolidation (transfer from cerebellar cortex to nucleus).

Located in dorsal cap subdivision of inferior olive in medulla. Receives visual error signals (retinal slip) from accessory optic system (AOS) and nucleus of the optic tract (NOT); provides climbing fiber (CF) teaching signals to floccular Purkinje cells via monosynaptic glutamatergic projections inducing complex spikes. Primary source of error signal driving VOR adaptation. Receives indirect GABAergic feedback from Purkinje cells (via FTN interneurons) to regulate learning rate. noROI(input).

Collective term for oculomotor nucleus (CN III), trochlear nucleus (CN IV), and abducens nucleus (CN VI). Receives eye movement commands from vestibular nucleus FTNs via medial longitudinal fasciculus (MLF); drives extraocular muscles to generate VOR eye movements. Final common pathway for VOR motor output. noROI(output); no outgoing projections within this circuit.
